src="https://cdn.trustindex.io/assets/platform/Tripadvisor/star/f.svg" alt="Tripadvisor star 2" width="17" height="17" loading="lazy" /><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="ti-star skip-lazy" src="https://cdn.trustindex.io/assets/platform/Tripadvisor/star/f.svg" alt="Tripadvisor star 3" width="17" height="17" loading="lazy" /><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="ti-star skip-lazy" src="https://cdn.trustindex.io/assets/platform/Tripadvisor/star/f.svg" alt="Tripadvisor star 4" width="17" height="17" loading="lazy" /><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="ti-star skip-lazy" class="ti-verified-tooltip">Verificada</span></span></span> <div class="ti-review-text-container ti-review-content"><!-- R-CONTENT --><strong>Fantastic place to have fun kitesurfing and relax!</strong>&#010;I spent one week at Ikarus to learn kitesurfing as a beginner. It was a blast! Kitesurfing: Both the natural conditions and the crew were perfect to learn. My instructor was Enrique, a fantastic guy and teacher. They efficiently teach you how to set up and take care of the equipment, and it's time to go in the water. From there it was super fun to learn and progress. The water is shallow in the entire lagoon, so when falling, you just get up, control your kite and board, and go again! The place: It's not a 5 star hotel with everything you'd find in the US. It's a little piece of quiet paradise. The rooms are simple, clean, and convenient. There are also options to camp. Everyone was super welcoming and nice. I went solo, but ended up seating with fellow visitors or even the family owning the place almost every meal. So I would alternate the days between a few hours of kitesurfing, reading a book, eating, or chatting with a drink. Perfect vacation to have fun and relax.<!-- R-CONTENT --></div> <span class="ti-read-more" data-container=".ti-review-content" data-collapse-text="Ocultar" data-open-text="Leer más"></span> </div> Nous avons passé un moment inoubliable avec mon mari dans ce spot de kitesurf exceptionnel. La plage est tout simplement magnifique, sauvage et paisible, comme seuls au monde… Loin des immeubles et de l’agitation urbaine, c’est un lieu parfait pour se reconnecter à la nature. Entre les oiseaux et autres animaux à observer, le cadre est d’une beauté rare. Le restaurant sur place est délicieux, chaque plat une vraie découverte. Un immense merci à Foka et sa femme pour leur accueil chaleureux, ainsi qu’à toute l’équipe : tous ont été d’une gentillesse et d’une bienveillance remarquables.
